name: the_picture_is_to_scale
why: ENTRY Z-F5. The most frequent input in a small workshop is a photo or a pen sketch: the image must be put into a sketch, TO SCALE, to trace over it. A 400 x 200 pixel PNG (Bench/data/retrace_400x200.png: a black rectangle on white) 120 mm wide, with the bottom-left corner at 10,20. Measured on 27/9/2026 (prova0089 zf5): it goes in at 1 px = 1 mm, SetSize and SetOrigin bring it where asked, and GetPointOnSketchFromPixel wants (column, row) contrary to the name of its arguments.
defect_caught: The image put in at 1 px = 1 mm (400 mm instead of 120); the scale believed because SetSize answered true; the PDF taken for an image.

expect.tolerance_why: read back from GetSize, in metres and rounded
the same: the locked aspect ratio
399 columns by 0.3 mm, from the two pixels brought into the sketch
expect.why: the scale verified on the image, not believed
